light_setup: 420 nm LED array surrounding reactor coil

streams.pump_role: Liquid feed containing substrate and photocatalyst
streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan stream_logic dictates single liquid stream. Flow rate derived from calculation target Q=0.5 mL/min to achieve residence time.
Chemistry Plan requires air as oxidant. Calculation specifies 5.34 sccm to meet O2 transfer sufficiency targets.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan states all components can be mixed prior to irradiation. Gas-liquid mixing required for O2 mass transfer.
pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve Fmoc-L-methionine and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole in acetonitrile to 0.1 M.
Pressurize air line with MFC set to 5.34 sccm.
chemistry_notes: Photo-oxidation of methionine to sulfoxide. Oxygen is a reactant; deoxygenation is prohibited. Reaction is mass-transfer limited (Da >> 1), requiring efficient gas-liquid mixing. Short residence time (0.3 min) enabled by high photon flux in flow. BPR required to maintain O2 solubility (Henry's Law) and prevent gas expansion.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2: tau = 0.3 min based on 15x intensification factor. Analogy 2 used 16 min but had poor mass transfer; our flow design improves mass transfer allowing shorter time.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Gas-liquid system. Using inlet/STP basis as per universal physics rules for gas-liquid feeds. In-channel time is lower due to pressure compression of gas.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Batch condition 21 C. No thermal advantage needed. Analogy 1 used 200 C for thermal cascade, not applicable here.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: BPR REQUIRED 3.0 bar to maintain gas solubility and prevent degassing. Analogy 2 used 10 bar for similar photo-oxidation.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP preferred for photocatalysis (transparent to 420 nm). Analogy 3 used FEP. Analogy 2 used PFA (also acceptable, but FEP standard for visible light).
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Batch condition 0.1 M. Analogy 1 used 0.5 M, but calculation Step 8 notes productivity closure fail if C_feed not optimized; sticking to batch C for safety/yield validation first.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculation Step 3: V_R = 1.11 mL based on tau=0.3 min and Q=0.5 mL/min.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: Calculation Step 3: d = 1.00 mm. Balances light penetration (small ID) and pressure drop. Analogy 2 did not specify ID but used PFA tubing.
